title: You compatibility inventory vocabulary
description: Shared vocabulary for family compatibility inventories that classify baseline aliases and compatibility-only public surfaces. Classification metadata does not control runtime callability.

family.description: The transport family owning one compatibility inventory record.

classification.description: Maintainer classification for one compatibility surface. remove-now means removal-ready for a later approved removal story, not physically removed in the inventory item.

approvalStatus.description: Maintainer approval status for the recorded classification and removal gates.

evidence.description: Reviewed evidence that the public name is compatibility-only or otherwise inventoried for migration.

references.description: Optional repository-relative paths or stable evidence identifiers supporting the summary.

removalGate.description: One objective gate that must be satisfied before a compatibility surface may be removed in a later approved change.

record.description: One classified compatibility alias or compatibility-only public surface.

publicName.description: The compatibility-facing public name callers may still use while the surface remains callable.
